        var odoo = ;

        (function () {
            var INSTANCE_ID = ;
            var POLL_MS     = 4000;
            var LINES       = 500;

            var allLines   = [];   // all fetched lines
            var query      = '';   // current search query
            var liveTimer  = null;

            var terminal    = document.getElementById('terminal');
            var svcSelect   = document.getElementById('svc-select');
            var searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');
            var btnLive     = document.getElementById('btn-live');
            var statusEl    = document.getElementById('status-text');
            var lineCountEl = document.getElementById('line-count');
            var emptyMsg    = document.getElementById('empty-msg');
            var filterInfo  = document.getElementById('filter-info');

            /* ── RPC ── */
            function rpc(method, params) {
                return fetch('/web/dataset/call_kw', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(),
                        params: {
                            model: 'cloud.instance', method: 'dummy',
                            args: [], kwargs: {},
                        },
                    }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); });
            }

            function fetchJson(url, body) {
                return fetch(url, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'X-Csrf-Token': odoo.csrf_token,
                    },
                    credentials: 'same-origin',
                    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'call', id: Date.now(), params: body }),
                }).then(function (r) { return r.json(); }).then(function (r) { return r.result; });
            }

            /* ── ANSI SGR → styled spans ──
             * Docker compose logs stream ANSI escape sequences
             * (``\x1b[…m``) when the service uses a TTY. Without a
             * parser the ESC byte renders as a ▯ box in the middle
             * of every line. Same logic as in log_terminal_page.xml
             * — kept inline to avoid an asset bundle for a standalone
             * HTML page. */
            var ANSI_BASIC = {
                30:'#000', 31:'#e06060', 32:'#60c060', 33:'#e0c060', 34:'#6088e0', 35:'#c060c0', 36:'#4ec9b0', 37:'#d4d4d4',
                90:'#666', 91:'#f48771', 92:'#8ae066', 93:'#ffd060', 94:'#88aaff', 95:'#ff88ff', 96:'#88ffff', 97:'#fff'
            };
            function ansi256(n) {
                if (n < 16) return ANSI_BASIC[n < 8 ? 30 + n : 82 + n];
                if (n < 232) {
                    n -= 16;
                    var scale = [0, 95, 135, 175, 215, 255];
                    return 'rgb(' + scale[Math.floor(n/36)] + ',' + scale[Math.floor((n%36)/6)] + ',' + scale[n%6] + ')';
                }
                var v = 8 + (n - 232) * 10;
                return 'rgb(' + v + ',' + v + ',' + v + ')';
            }
            function applyAnsiCodes(state, raw) {
                var codes = (raw === '' ? [0] : raw.split(';').map(function (x) { return parseInt(x, 10); }));
                for (var i = 0; i < codes.length; i++) {
                    var c = codes[i];
                    if (!isFinite(c) || c === 0)      { state.fg = null; state.bg = null; state.bold = false; state.dim = false; state.italic = false; state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 1)                 { state.bold = true; }
                    else if (c === 2)                 { state.dim = true; }
                    else if (c === 3)                 { state.italic = true; }
                    else if (c === 4)                 { state.underline = true; }
                    else if (c === 22)                { state.bold = false; state.dim = false; }
                    else if (c === 23)                { state.italic = false; }
                    else if (c === 24)                { state.underline = false; }
                    else if (c === 39)                { state.fg = null; }
                    else if (c === 49)                { state.bg = null; }
                    else if (c >= 30 && c <= 37)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 40 && c <= 47)     { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c >= 90 && c <= 97)     { state.fg = ANSI_BASIC[c]; }
                    else if (c >= 100 && c <= 107)   { state.bg = ANSI_BASIC[c - 10]; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.fg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 5) { state.bg = ansi256(codes[i+2] || 0); i += 2; }
                    else if (c === 38 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.fg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                    else if (c === 48 && codes[i+1] === 2) { state.bg = 'rgb(' + (codes[i+2]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+3]||0) + ',' + (codes[i+4]||0) + ')'; i += 4; }
                }
            }
            function emitRun(parent, text, state) {
                if (!text) return;
                if (!state.fg && !state.bg && !state.bold && !state.dim && !state.italic && !state.underline) {
                    parent.appendChild(document.createTextNode(text));
                    return;
                }
                var span = document.createElement('span');
                var css = '';
                if (state.fg) css += 'color:' + state.fg + ';';
                if (state.bg) css += 'background:' + state.bg + ';';
                if (state.bold) css += 'font-weight:bold;';
                if (state.dim) css += 'opacity:0.65;';
                if (state.italic) css += 'font-style:italic;';
                if (state.underline) css += 'text-decoration:underline;';
                span.style.cssText = css;
                span.textContent = text;
                parent.appendChild(span);
            }
            function appendAnsiText(parent, text) {
                var re = /\x1b\[([0-9;]*)m/g;
                var state = { fg: null, bg: null, bold: false, dim: false, italic: false, underline: false };
                var last = 0;
                var m;
                while ((m = re.exec(text)) !== null) {
                    if (m.index > last) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last, m.index), state);
                    applyAnsiCodes(state, m[1]);
                    last = re.lastIndex;
                }
                if (last < text.length) emitRun(parent, text.slice(last), state);
            }

            /* ── Render ── */
            function render() {
                var filtered = query
                    ? allLines.filter(function (l) { return l.toLowerCase().indexOf(query) !== -1; })
                    : allLines;

                // remove old log lines (keep emptyMsg node)
                while (terminal.firstChild) terminal.removeChild(terminal.firstChild);
                terminal.appendChild(emptyMsg);

                if (filtered.length === 0) {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = '';
                    emptyMsg.textContent   = allLines.length ? 'No lines match the filter.' : 'No log output.';
                } else {
                    emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
                    var frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
                    filtered.forEach(function (line) {
                        var div = document.createElement('div');
                        div.className = 'log-line' + (query ? ' hl' : '');
                        appendAnsiText(div, line);
                        frag.appendChild(div);
                    });
                    terminal.appendChild(frag);
                }

                lineCountEl.textContent = (query
                    ? filtered.length + ' / ' + allLines.length
                    : allLines.length) + ' lines';

                if (query) {
                    filterInfo.style.display = '';
                    filterInfo.textContent   = 'Filtering: "' + query + '"';
                } else {
                    filterInfo.style.display = 'none';
                }

                // always scroll to bottom
                terminal.scrollTop = terminal.scrollHeight;
            }

            /* ── Fetch logs ── */
            function fetchLogs() {
                var svc = svcSelect.value;
                if (!svc) return;
                setStatus('loading', 'Loading…');
                fetchJson('/cloud/fetch_container_logs', {
                    instance_id: INSTANCE_ID,
                    service:     svc,
                    lines:       LINES,
                }).then(function (result) {
                    if (!result) { setStatus('error', 'No response.'); return; }
                    if (result.ok) {
                        allLines = result.lines || [];
                        render();
                        setStatus('', svc + ' — ' + new Date().toLocaleTimeString());
                    } else {
                        setStatus('error', result.error || 'Error.');
                    }
                }).catch(function () {
                    setStatus('error', 'Connection error.');
                });
            }

            function setStatus(cls, text) {
                statusEl.className    = cls;
                statusEl.textContent  = text;
            }

            /* ── Live toggle ── */
            function startLive() {
                if (liveTimer) return;
                fetchLogs();
                liveTimer = setInterval(fetchLogs, POLL_MS);
                btnLive.textContent = '⏸ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-on';
            }

            function stopLive() {
                clearInterval(liveTimer);
                liveTimer = null;
                btnLive.textContent = '▶ Live';
                btnLive.className   = 'btn btn-live-off';
            }

            btnLive.addEventListener('click', function () {
                if (liveTimer) { stopLive(); } else { startLive(); }
            });

            /* ── Service change ── */
            svcSelect.addEventListener('change', function () {
                allLines = [];
                render();
                fetchLogs();
            });

            /* ── Search ── */
            var searchTimer = null;
            searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                clearTimeout(searchTimer);
                searchTimer = setTimeout(function () {
                    query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
                    render();
                }, 200);
            });

            /* ── Init ── */
            if (svcSelect.options.length) {
                fetchLogs();
            }
        })();
